title: PoseSpace free downloads: evidence register
scope: Page text, links, metadata, and metasearch results; no authenticated account, bonus redemption, purchase, downloaded ZIP, or file dimensions tested.

labels.verified-live: Page or metadata was fetched; attributed claims remain the source's claims, not independently proven facts.
labels.indexed: Search snippet only; potentially stale or incomplete.
labels.historical: Dated older source; not necessarily current.
labels.unverified: Workflow or outcome has not been tested.

open_questions: Confirm signup sample identity, sizes and contents through an account with the user's consent.
Verify current zero-credit promotions and check price before any transaction.
Test sample ZIP download and image dimensions; compare the two official sample sites if needed.
Test bonus redemption only using a legitimately owned book and record actual conditions.
Ask publisher to reconcile preview dimensions, educational use and disputed archive provenance.
Direct sample JPEG fetches returned HTTP 500 from the page-fetch tool; retry in a normal browser without inferring that the files are unavailable.
